amenities.title: The extraordinary is part of the everyday.
amenities.subtitle: Golf, marina, aviation, nature and river. All inside AguaVista.

golf.title: Golf
golf.description: Championship 18-hole course with driving range and academy.
golf.descriptionLong: Eighteen par-72 holes designed around the natural slope of the land towards the river. Floodlit driving range, putting green, academy with certified instructors, and a club house with changing rooms and club storage. Owners play with no green fee and no booking required on weekdays.

nautica.title: Marina
nautica.description: Private marina with moorings and direct access to the Paraná River.
nautica.descriptionLong: Private marina with moorings for vessels up to 12 metres, its own launch ramp, covered dry storage and a fuel pump inside the grounds. Direct access to the main Paraná channel: twenty minutes and you are in open water.

playa.title: Beach
playa.description: Private sand beach on the river, with full bar service.
playa.descriptionLong: Three hundred metres of imported, maintained sand along the riverbank, with parasols, loungers and full bar and food service in season. Marked swimming area, lifeguards in summer and a separate zone for children's play.

tenis.title: Tennis House
tenis.description: Floodlit clay courts and a dedicated club house.
tenis.descriptionLong: Four clay courts with LED floodlighting for night play and two hard courts. The club house has changing rooms, a functional gym, a canteen and a terrace looking straight onto the centre courts.

spa.title: Spa & Wellness
spa.description: Hydrotherapy circuit, treatment rooms and a fully equipped gym.
spa.descriptionLong: Full hydrotherapy circuit with heated pool, dry sauna, steam room and Scottish shower. Three massage rooms, a facial treatment room and a gym fitted with latest-generation equipment plus space for functional classes.

aeropuerto.title: Executive airport
aeropuerto.description: Private airstrip and hangars inside the community.
aeropuerto.descriptionLong: A 1,200-metre paved runway approved for general aviation, with night lighting, wind sock and its own frequency. Hangars for rent or purchase and an apron for parking. Twelve minutes' flight from Asunción.

jardin.title: Japanese garden
jardin.description: Landscaping, water and quiet for an unhurried walk.
jardin.descriptionLong: One hectare of Japanese landscaping with an artificial lake, red bridge, stone paths and more than forty species chosen to flower at different times of the year. Made for an early walk or one at dusk, with no noise and no traffic.

agua.title: Water treatment plant
agua.description: Our own drinking water infrastructure serving the whole community.
agua.descriptionLong: Our own water treatment plant drawing from the river, with multi-layer filtration, automatic chlorination and monthly bacteriological testing. Two elevated tanks guarantee constant pressure across the whole property and seventy-two hours of reserve.

items.a: AguaVista is a residential country club in Paraguay combining real estate, golf, beach, marina, sports, and an executive airport. If you'd like to explore available options, I can put you in touch with an advisor.
It's in San Juan del Paraná, very close to Encarnación and the border with Argentina. Let me know where you're coming from, and an advisor can explain the best way to get here.

items.q: What properties are available to buy?
items.a: There are different options for lots, houses, and other properties, and availability changes constantly. To receive current options and prices, it's best to speak directly with an advisor.

items.q: How much does a property in AguaVista cost?
items.a: It depends on the location, size, and type of property. We have alternatives for different budgets. Would you like an advisor to send you today's available options?
Yes, there are transactions with foreign buyers, though requirements may vary depending on nationality and property. An advisor can review your case and explain the process.

items.q: Do I need Paraguayan residency to buy?
items.a: Not necessarily. The situation depends on each buyer and the property. If you let me know your nationality, I can refer you to an advisor to guide you properly.
Some properties may offer different payment terms or financing. To find out about current options, speak with an advisor.

items.q: How much are the HOA/maintenance fees?
items.a: The amount can depend on the property and current club conditions. An advisor can give you the updated fee and explain what it includes.

items.q: Does AguaVista have a golf course?
items.a: Yes. Golf is one of AguaVista's great differentiators, along with the beach, the marina, and its sports facilities. If you want to know about properties near or overlooking the golf course, I can connect you with an advisor.

items.q: Does AguaVista have its own airport?
items.a: Yes. AguaVista features AVA – AguaVista Airport Executive. For information on flight operations or to arrange a visit, speak directly with an advisor.

items.q: Does it have a beach and river access?
items.a: Yes. AguaVista offers a lifestyle linked to the Paraná River, with a beach and nautical activities. If you want to see the club in person, we can arrange a visit.

items.q: Can I rent out my property?
items.a: There are properties within AguaVista intended for short-term rental. Conditions depend on the property and current regulations. An advisor can explain which properties are best suited for investment.

items.q: What return on investment can a property generate?
items.a: Profitability depends on purchase price, property type, rates, occupancy, and expenses. To run real numbers on a specific property, speak with an advisor.

items.q: Can I visit AguaVista before buying?
items.a: Yes. We can arrange a visit so you can see the club, its amenities, and available properties. Let me know what day you'd like to come, and I'll connect you with an advisor.

items.q: I want to buy or invest, who do I talk to?
items.a: With an advisor from Solari Bienes Raíces.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: At AguaVista we treat your personal data with the same care we give the property itself. This policy explains what information we collect, what we use it for, and what rights you have over it.

sections.title: AguaVista S.A., with registered address at Antequera esquina 25 de mayo, local 1., Encarnación, Paraguay, is the controller
sections.body: AguaVista S.A., with registered address at San Juan del Paraná, Itapúa, Paraguay, is the controller of the personal data collected through this website. You can reach us at info@aguavista.com.py with any question about this policy.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
sections.body: We only collect the data you give us voluntarily through the contact form: full name, email, phone number, enquiry type and the message you write. We also record anonymous technical browsing data (pages visited, device type, language) for statistical purposes.

sections.title: 3. What we use your data for
sections.body: We use your data exclusively to answer your enquiry, arrange visits to the property, send you the commercial information about lots and amenities you requested, and improve the site experience. We do not make automated decisions that produce legal effects on you.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis and consent
sections.body: Processing is based on the consent you give by ticking the checkbox on the contact form. You can withdraw that consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out beforehand.

sections.title: 5. Who we share your data with
sections.body: We do not sell or transfer your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes. We only share it with service providers that help us operate the site (hosting, database and email delivery), acting as processors under contractual confidentiality obligations.

sections.title: 6. How long we keep it
sections.body: We keep contact data for the duration of the commercial relationship and for up to 24 months after your last interaction with us, unless you request deletion earlier or a legal obligation requires us to keep it longer.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access your data, correct it if inaccurate, request its deletion, object to its processing and request data portability. To exercise these rights, write to info@aguavista.com.py stating your full name and the right you wish to exercise. We respond within 10 business days.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
sections.body: This site uses technical cookies needed to remember your language and your theme preference (light or dark). We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. You can delete them from your browser settings at any time.

sections.title: 9. Security
sections.body: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data: encryption in transit via HTTPS, access control on the admin panel, and regular database backups.

sections.title: 10. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy to reflect legal or process changes. When we do, we will update the last-updated date shown at the top. We recommend reviewing it periodically.

sections.title: 8. Service availability

sections.title: 11. Governing law and jurisdiction
